instruction: I'm using Ubuntu and need to set GIMP as the default application for editing image files. Could you help configure this?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting GIMP as default image editor. Evaluator checks xdg-mime settings for common editable image MIME types (png, jpeg, bmp, etc.) to verify gimp.desktop is registered. Similar complexity to original VLC task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default image editor by querying xdg-mime for common editable image MIME types (bmp, jpeg, jpg, png, tiff, x-bmp, x-png)
Getter uses Counter to return the most common default app across all MIME types, which robustly verifies GIMP is set as the default image editor
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies 'gimp.desktop' is included in the result string
Expected value 'gimp.desktop' is semantically correct for GIMP application on Ubuntu
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting GIMP as default, evaluator verifies this by checking system settings
No postconfig needed: xdg-mime settings persist and can be queried after task completion
Edge case handling: getter returns 'unknown' if no apps registered, metric will correctly return 0.0
